_comment: Source of truth for the resume records, applied by `manage.py sync_resume`. Contact details beyond the public email are deliberately excluded: this file is committed to a public repository.

jobs.title: QA & Automation Consultant
jobs.description: Freelance QA and test automation engagements covering test strategy, framework design, defect analysis and release readiness for client applications.
jobs.more_details:
• Build end-to-end automation frameworks in Playwright and TypeScript using the Page Object Model and spec-driven development practices.
  • Apply AI-assisted testing workflows to test design, maintenance and failure triage.
  • Operate a self-hosted infrastructure lab (Docker, NAS, uptime monitoring, networking) to maintain hands-on reliability and operations skills.

jobs.title: Principal Technical Project Manager
jobs.description: Led delivery of a digital transformation program at a major U.S. insurance carrier in a SOX-regulated environment, managing an offshore development team delivering new capabilities for insurance brokers.
jobs.more_details:
• Took over a project that had been stalled for two years without a release and delivered it to production within five months, driving scope control, dependency management and release readiness.
  • Introduced Agile delivery practices in a predominantly waterfall organisation, working through significant resistance to process change to establish a working delivery cadence.
  • Reported delivery status, risks and dependencies daily to the U.S.-based Senior Manager and weekly to the Delivery Manager, escalating blockers for resolution.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager, Platform & Cloud Operations
jobs.description: Managed a 35+ member DevOps and Cloud organisation across Brazil, Portugal and China, providing 24/7 follow-the-sun coverage for a high-availability B2B e-commerce platform processing over 30 million orders a month across 20 countries.
jobs.more_details:
• Served as the DevOps and Cloud focal point for production incidents: engaged on every Severity 1, 2 and 3 incident, brought the right engineers into the war room and coordinated diagnosis and recovery within defined SLAs.
  • Communicated incident status from identification to resolution, keeping engaged teams, support and business stakeholders aligned through structured updates.
  • Contributed technical root cause findings to post-incident reviews and carried the resulting preventive actions through the DevOps backlog to completion.
  • Designed a service request triage model in Jira Service Management for a platform used by 1,500+ developers, classifying hundreds of daily requests against defined response targets.
  • Reviewed service metrics weekly with the system architects, establishing a continual improvement cadence across three platform teams.
  • Removed the access-provisioning bottleneck those metrics exposed by automating manager approvals in Power Automate and folding them into onboarding, cutting access requests from around 7 days to around 2.
  • Led CI/CD, Disaster Recovery and High Availability initiatives, increasing deployment success rate to over 96%.

jobs.title: Scrum Master
jobs.description: Coached 12+ engineers on Agile and Scrum practices, improving sprint predictability and completion rates.
jobs.more_details:
• Removed delivery impediments and coordinated cross-functional teams to resolve issues and maintain delivery flow.
  • Implemented velocity, quality and throughput metrics to support data-driven improvement decisions.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Lead
jobs.description: Led and mentored a team of 5+ QA engineers across value streams, working on-site with a U.S. enterprise client.
jobs.more_details:
• Owned QA planning, estimation, risk management, defect reporting and release readiness.
  • Established root cause analysis and quality metrics that reduced defect leakage to production by around 30%.

jobs.title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.description: Designed and scaled automation frameworks using Selenium WebDriver and Robot Framework, reducing manual regression effort by around 70%.
jobs.more_details: • Led release quality for multi-country expansions, executing four on-site go-lives with no critical post-release issues.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Engineer / Software Engineer
jobs.description: Provided N2/N3 production support, troubleshooting application issues and contributing to faster incident resolution.
jobs.more_details: • Developed automation in Python and JavaScript and supported CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins on Google Cloud Platform.
